Spiritual curiosity without a new identity

Three different ways into a question: a conversation, some context, and a map of possible explanations. Choose one, not a syllabus.

Worth a few minutes.

Essay · 3 min read

Start here: the questions behind Living Well

A short introduction to the interests behind this section, with one idea, one free resource, and one practical place to begin.

Essay · 3 min read

Can you be spiritually curious without pretending to be certain?

Keep wonder, skepticism, and personal meaning in the same conversation without forcing them to become the same thing.

Essay · 4 min read

What is the time you save actually for?

Before adding another automation, decide what the recovered time is meant to make possible and count the work the tool creates.

Essay · 3 min read

What should you decide personally, even when a tool helps you express it?

Use help with wording without outsourcing responsibility, inventing feelings, or making promises you do not intend to keep.

Essay · 3 min read

The difference between improving your life and believing you are never enough

Choose a specific change without making your whole self the problem, and leave room for limits, acceptance, and outside support.

Essay · 3 min read

What makes an ordinary moment feel sacred?

Explore attention, ritual, wonder, and unanswered questions without claiming that a meaningful experience proves its explanation.

Essay · 3 min read

Can an AI-generated reflection be meaningful?

Distinguish a reader's response from the origin, accuracy, and authority of a passage, and keep AI in the role of a thinking aid.

Essay · 3 min read

When does documenting your life get in the way of experiencing it?

Choose what to record, what to keep private, and when to put the camera away without treating documentation as either all good or all bad.

Essay · 5 min read

Choosing between two good lives

Examine meaningful tradeoffs, test whether a plan fits ordinary days, and review disappointment without pretending every choice has one correct answer.

Essay · 4 min read

When technology helps you notice more

Merlin, Seek, and a no-app alternative: use a small tool to investigate something already in front of you, then return to the world.

Essay · 5 min read

Consciousness: which question are we asking?

A plain-language way into experience, scientific explanations, philosophical disagreement, and questions about AI.

Essay · 4 min read

A useful tool can make itself less necessary

An argument for judging technology by what it enables, including the ability to finish, learn, simplify, and leave.
